items: Independent review fails closed without an explicit PASS/ISSUES verdict, and reviews pin to one certified commit plus byte-exact untracked file manifests
Ready-gate recaptures the contribution diff at HEAD, refuses to restamp when the package changed, and soft-chips behind-main / merge conflicts
Roadmap delivery lineage is projected from the full backlog and run stores so historical runs stay visible with durable backlinks
Dispatch exclusive claim protocol and Codex multi-account seat bind/failover keep concurrent queue work and provider seats honest
Worktree branch diffs include uncommitted and untracked files; git.status exposes HEAD SHA so clients can invalidate committed-diff caches after rebases
